label: ريم — نجدية
ref_text: نقبل البطاقات الائتمانية، وبطاقات مدى، والتحويل البنكي، والدفع عند الاستلام في مدن محددة.
source: omnivoice-finetune/data/najdi_cs/wavs/najdi_cs_11_najdi_s7_09_clean_001.wav (id najdi_cs_00111, cut from set 11's najdi_s7_09_clean.wav; no najdi_cs clip is in najdi_mix_v3, so the shipped checkpoint never trained on this voice)
notes: The female voice of the synthetic najdi_cs customer-support sets, where the agent calls herself Reem (sets 7-11), Noura (set 3) and Sara (set 13): one synthesiser voice under several names (speaker similarity 0.87 across its 74 recordings). The omnivoice_najdi model only clones it. From set 11, her regular professional delivery. Picked from 42 candidate segments of 5-9 s: of the eight cloned with the shipped model this gave the closest clones (similarity 0.791, next 0.763) at an UTMOS (3.56) level with the rest.
